#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH --account=lcalculus
#SBATCH --job-name=cascadelake_full_v5
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=16
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4
#SBATCH --constraint=cascadelake
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --time=168:00:00
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=5G
#SBATCH --mail-type=BEGIN,END,FAIL
#SBATCH --mail-user=nathan.cornille@kuleuven.be
#SBATCH --output=%x-%j.out

# The PBS directive '#PBS -j oe' (join output/error) is handled in Slurm
# by specifying only the --output flag, which merges stdout and stderr by default.

source $HOME/.bashrc
conda activate devlbert

python train_concap.py --config config/pretrain_concap_devlbert.yml --region_mask_prob .3 --trainer.auto_select_gpus false --pt2_run --trainer.gpus 4 --train_batch_size 128 --checkpoint_every_n_train_steps 0 --output_dir /scratch/leuven/336/vsc33642/v5_devlbert_checkpunten
